metadata.title: Clicked like a confused potato and somehow scored my ONE kill? Valorant’s math is broken!
metadata.description:
Me: no clue what I’m doing
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
Valorant: handing out 1 kill like a participation trophy
Tap if you’ve ever gotten a kill that made zero sense!

Click if your aim is a beautiful disaster too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
